A Construction Approach of Model Transfo.title: A Construction Approach of Model Transformation Rules Based on Rough Set Theory
A Construction Approach of Model Transfo.key_insight: 将粗糙集理论扩展到支持不同元模型之间的映射,重新定义条件属性和决策属性,实现转换规则的半自动构建。
A Construction Approach of Model Transfo.method_signature: 基于扩展粗糙集理论构建模型转换规则rsCRT算法,包含决策表生成、兼容性检测、决策矩阵构建和规则生成四步。

A Data-driven Approach for Constructing.title: A Data-driven Approach for Constructing Multilayer Network-based Service Ecosystem Models

A Data-driven Approach for Constructing.method_signature: MSEM多层网络模型+新闻语料NLP联合学习+主动学习标注

A Design Method of Reusable Components B.title: A Design Method of Reusable Components Based on Feature Matching
A Design Method of Reusable Components B.key_insight: 用图结构层次聚类+扩展Sorenson系数自动计算实体相似度,无需人工权重
A Design Method of Reusable Components B.method_signature: 基于图的层次聚类+扩展Sorenson系数+领域词库语义相似度

A FP-Tree Based Approach for Mining All.title: A FP-Tree Based Approach for Mining All Strongly Correlated Pairs without Candidate Generation
A FP-Tree Based Approach for Mining All.key_insight: 利用FP-tree结构直接计算所有物品对的相关系数, 无需候选生成和上界剪枝, 对阈值θ不敏感
A FP-Tree Based Approach for Mining All.method_signature: Tcp: 构建完整FP-tree + 模式增长计算相关系数

A Link Clustering Based Approach for Clu.title: A Link Clustering Based Approach for Clustering Categorical Data
A Link Clustering Based Approach for Clu.key_insight: CDC问题与LC问题等价，两个领域的算法可以互换使用
A Link Clustering Based Approach for Clu.method_signature: 将分类数据属性等价类映射为链接，应用LC的概率生成模型聚类

A Log-based and Traceability-Oriented Bu.title: A Log-based and Traceability-Oriented Business Object Association Model for Code Generation
A Log-based and Traceability-Oriented Bu.key_insight: 将关联从对象内部剥离为独立日志,使简单操作处理单对象状态变更,复杂操作通过操作关联日志实现对象关联追踪
A Log-based and Traceability-Oriented Bu.method_signature: 业务对象模型+状态日志+关联日志+简单/复杂操作分离+代码生成工具

A New Paradigm of Software Service Engin.title: A New Paradigm of Software Service Engineering in the Era of Big Data and Big Service
A New Paradigm of Software Service Engin.key_insight: 将软件服务工程重构为双向两阶段范式：自上而下需求工程与自下而上领域服务工程，以服务上下文作为需求模式与服务模式匹配的媒介
A New Paradigm of Software Service Engin.method_signature: RE2SEP范式含服务导向需求工程、领域导向服务工程、软件开发方法三个组件

A Survey Of Business Component Identific.title: A Survey of Business Component Identification Methods and Related Techniques
A Survey Of Business Component Identific.key_insight: 现有方法各有侧重：领域工程方法优化复用性与稳定性，聚类方法降低复用成本，CRUD方法保证语义完整性
A Survey Of Business Component Identific.method_signature: 将组件识别方法分为四类：领域工程法、聚类分析法、CRUD矩阵法、其他方法并进行比较分析

A Unified Subspace Outlier Ensemble Fram.title: A Unified Subspace Outlier Ensemble Framework for Outlier Detection in High Dimensional Spaces
A Unified Subspace Outlier Ensemble Fram.key_insight: 所有现有离群点检测方法都可视为子空间集合和组合函数两种参数的不同取值
A Unified Subspace Outlier Ensemble Fram.method_signature: SOE1算法：仅用一维权值子空间，两次扫描数据集，基于直方图计算

Clustering Categorical Data Streams.title: Clustering Categorical Data Streams
Clustering Categorical Data Streams.key_insight: Apply lossy counting histogram approximation to Squeezer algorithm yields bounded memory one-pass categorical clustering
Clustering Categorical Data Streams.method_signature: StreamCluCD combines Squeezer clustering with lossy counting histogram pruning

Clustering Mixed Numeric and Categorical.title: Clustering Mixed Numeric and Categorical Data: A Cluster Ensemble Approach
Clustering Mixed Numeric and Categorical.key_insight: 聚类输出本身是类别标签,可作为类别属性处理;利用Squeezer算法支持加权属性相似度计算来解决不同子数据集的权重平衡
Clustering Mixed Numeric and Categorical.method_signature: CEBMDC: 先分割数据集为纯类别和纯数值子集,分别聚类后合并为类别数据集再聚类集成

Community-Based Service Ecosystem Evolut.title: Community-Based Service Ecosystem Evolution Analysis
Community-Based Service Ecosystem Evolut.key_insight: 服务社区比整体生态系统更敏感，能更早感知生态系统演化趋势，提供整体层面无法获取的独特洞察
Community-Based Service Ecosystem Evolut.method_signature: 随机森林分类器+SHAP可解释性分析，从社区视角预测服务生态演化

Domain Priori Knowledge based Integrated.title: Domain Priori Knowledge based Integrated Solution Design for Internet of Services
Domain Priori Knowledge based Integrated.key_insight: 利用历史UR与历史ISS的共性与相似性提取需求模式(RP)和服务模式(SP),构建双向概率匹配矩阵。
Domain Priori Knowledge based Integrated.method_signature: I-Tree建模→RP覆盖→PMM匹配SP→ISS快速生成

DySR_ A Dynamic Representation Learning.title: DySR: A Dynamic Representation Learning and Aligning based Model for Service Bundle Recommendation
DySR_ A Dynamic Representation Learning.key_insight: 通过可学习的仿射变换函数消除表示鸿沟,利用动态图表示学习捕捉服务的演化社会环境,实现无需交互历史即可推荐
DySR_ A Dynamic Representation Learning.method_signature: DySR结合动态图表示学习(DyRep变体)、表示对齐(仿射变换)和GAN风格协同训练

Enterprise Interoperability.title: Enterprise Interoperability
Enterprise Interoperability.key_insight: 价值创造从单向转向双向，企业成功取决于与任意伙伴的互操作能力
Enterprise Interoperability.method_signature: IWEI会议征稿覆盖理论框架、架构方法、成熟度模型与应用案例的完整研究谱系

External Service Sensing (ESS)_ Research.title: External Service Sensing (ESS): Research Framework, Challenges and Opportunities
External Service Sensing (ESS)_ Research.key_insight: ESS是其他服务计算问题的上游任务,需先感知变化才能提升实用性
External Service Sensing (ESS)_ Research.method_signature: 四维框架:感知对象、内容、渠道、技术组合定义具体ESS问题

IDENTIFYING BUSINESS COMPONENTS FROM BUS.title: IDENTIFYING BUSINESS COMPONENTS FROM BUSINESS MODEL: A METHOD BASED ON FEATURE MATCHING
IDENTIFYING BUSINESS COMPONENTS FROM BUS.key_insight: 引入等价特征关系，通过扩展Sorenson系数计算多元素相似度进行聚类
IDENTIFYING BUSINESS COMPONENTS FROM BUS.method_signature: 基于等价特征关系划分特征集+层次聚类识别业务组件

K-ANMI_ A Mutual Information Based Clust.title: K-ANMI: A Mutual Information Based Clustering Algorithm for Categorical Data
K-ANMI_ A Mutual Information Based Clust.key_insight: Treating each attribute's value partition as a clustering result allows reformulating categorical clustering as a cluster ensemble consensus problem.
K-ANMI_ A Mutual Information Based Clust.method_signature: k-means style iterative algorithm directly optimizing ANMI objective using histogram-based data structures for scalability.

K-Histograms_ An Efficient Clustering Al.title: K-Histograms: An Efficient Clustering Algorithm for Categorical Dataset
K-Histograms_ An Efficient Clustering Al.key_insight: 用直方图完整保留属性值频率分布，比mode更能刻画类别聚类的内部结构
K-Histograms_ An Efficient Clustering Al.method_signature: 用直方图表示簇，以公式(6)计算对象与直方图差异度，迭代优化聚类目标函数

Learning to Synthesize Compatible Fashio.title: Learning to Synthesize Compatible Fashion Items Using Semantic Alignment and Collocation Classification: An Outfit Generation Framework
Learning to Synthesize Compatible Fashio.venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
Learning to Synthesize Compatible Fashio.key_insight: 引入语义对齐模块捕获输入输出图像间的长程依赖关系,用Bi-LSTM建模顺序兼容性来监督生成过程
Learning to Synthesize Compatible Fashio.method_signature: OutfitGAN框架包含SAM语义对齐模块和CCM搭配分类模块,基于LSGAN目标和L1/perceptual损失

Lightweight Secure Directed Diffusion fo.title: Lightweight Secure Directed Diffusion for Wireless Sensor Networks
Lightweight Secure Directed Diffusion fo.venue: Hindawi Publishing Corporation (Mathematical Problems in Engineering)
Lightweight Secure Directed Diffusion fo.key_insight: 用延迟容忍单向哈希链认证配合黑名单机制，可在低开销下抵御多种路由攻击
Lightweight Secure Directed Diffusion fo.method_signature: 扩展定向扩散协议，集成延迟容忍单向哈希链认证和黑名单技术

Mass Customization Oriented and Cost-Eff.title: Mass Customization Oriented and Cost-Effective Service Network
Mass Customization Oriented and Cost-Eff.key_insight: 将服务网络作为持久基础设施而非临时组合，通过特征选择与组合优化实现动态定制。
Mass Customization Oriented and Cost-Eff.method_signature: 基于IN_Pool/OUT_Pool/Service_Pool的服务网络形式化定义与两阶段优化算法。

Novel Artificial Bee Colony Algorithms f.title: Novel Artificial Bee Colony Algorithms for QoS-Aware Service Selection
Novel Artificial Bee Colony Algorithms f.key_insight: Continuous ABC's success stems from 'optimality continuity' property (similar variables yield similar function values); discrete ABC lacks this because neighborhood covers entire solution space; approximating this property via QoS-similarity-based neighbors improves convergence.
Novel Artificial Bee Colony Algorithms f.method_signature: Three algorithms (IBA/PBA/EBA) achieve approximate optimality continuity through ratio-based, partition-based, and experience-based neighborhood definitions respectively.

Online Deployment Algorithms for Microse.title: Online Deployment Algorithms for Microservice Systems with Complex Dependencies
Online Deployment Algorithms for Microse.key_insight: 响应时间沿函数链可分解为相邻函数对响应时间之和,使FPP可转化为二次比值和问题(QSRFP)大幅降低复杂度
Online Deployment Algorithms for Microse.method_signature: 基于Theorem 1将FPP转化为QSRFP,提出B/D/BD-QSRFP三种贪心部署算法

Semantic Relation Based Exception Detect.title: Semantic Relation Based Exception Detection in Workflow Systems
Semantic Relation Based Exception Detect.key_insight: 数据依赖图G_Data是控制依赖图G_Ctrl的超图，利用数据依赖规则作为控制规则的语义补充，可在不改变schema结构的前提下检测异常路径
Semantic Relation Based Exception Detect.method_signature: 基于BFS的路径枚举(AllPath)+数据依赖规则验证(ExceptionChecking)+异常路径搜索(SearchAllExceptionPath)

Who Should I Engage with At What Time_ A.title: Who Should I Engage with At What Time? A Missing Event Aware Temporal Graph Neural Network
Who Should I Engage with At What Time_ A.key_insight: 缺失事件应作为独立的时序点过程与观测事件耦合，通过变分推断处理不可观测的缺失事件
Who Should I Engage with At What Time_ A.method_signature: MTGN：耦合观测/缺失事件TPP，用对数正态混合分布参数化时间，联合预测链接与时间
